response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and AI-agent infrastructure experience, particularly with TypeScript, Node.js, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. While his AI/GenAI expertise is not as deeply highlighted as required, his technical leadership, cloud-adjacent work, and open-source contributions suggest adaptability. A deeper dive into his AI-specific experience is warranted.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud technologies (AWS, Kubernetes), aligning with the role's technical stack.
Proven leadership in technical discovery and developer tooling (e.g., MCP code generators, agentic workflows at re:cinq).
Strong open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts) and mentorship through workshops/talks, indicating collaboration and knowledge-sharing skills.
concerns: Limited explicit evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions or deep expertise in RAG architectures/vector databases.
AI/GenAI experience is primarily recent (re:cinq) and not detailed in prior roles, raising questions about depth.
No mention of advanced degrees (Master's/PhD) or LLM performance metrics/optimization techniques, which are preferred qualifications.
